room_rent.note: VERIFY: room rent subject to eligible-room-category sub-limit per plan/schedule; proportionate deduction if exceeded (Standard/Silver/Gold)

icu.note: VERIFY: ICU charges subject to plan/schedule limits

copayment.note: VERIFY: co-pay/deductible defined per chosen Plan (Standard/Silver/Gold) in schedule; no fixed base value in wording

sub_limits.note: VERIFY: plan-based product with room-rent caps and Modern Treatment capped at 50% SI; other sub-limits per schedule

initial_waiting.note: VERIFY: standard Excl03 (not explicitly captured); inferred

ped_waiting.note: Excl01: 24 or 48 months as specified in schedule; best achievable 24mo

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); no maternity benefit found

cumulative_bonus.note: No SI cumulative bonus; only a premium 'No Claim Bonus' renewal discount 5%/yr up to 20%, forfeited on claim

pre_hosp.note: VERIFY: pre-hospitalisation days specified in Policy Schedule per plan

post_hosp.note: VERIFY: post-hospitalisation days specified in Policy Schedule per plan

domiciliary.note: Limited to 10% of SI; listed chronic conditions excluded

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation included in In-Patient benefit

ambulance.note: Local Road Ambulance up to schedule limit

modern_treatments.note: Modern Treatment (3.10) capped at 50% of SI

moratorium.note: Older-format moratorium of 8 continuous years (= 96 months)

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded (Excl18); domiciliary capped 10% SI & excludes listed chronic conditions; Modern Treatment capped 50% SI; plan-based room-rent caps

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness benefit, Daily Hospitalization Allowance, Nursing Allowance, Recovery Benefit (plan/schedule dependent)
